liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **France**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [11]
- **If I Had The World To Give**: rare: 5 archived performances [11]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Stagger Lee, I Need A Miracle [11]

## The recordings

- **gd78-08-18.sbd.tzuriel.11504.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 8 songs; 38 min; rated 4.11/5 by 9 [1]. Said about its sound: The audio quality is described as poor, resembling stink bait; The playing is relaxed and restrained, with an intimate sound quality [3][10]

## Around the show

- Lowell George sings lead vocals and possibly plays drums on this track [2]
- Lowell George sings lead on the first take, a moment called priceless [6]
- Lowell George plays electric slide guitar throughout this song [6]
- Lowell George plays slide guitar, solos, and sings backing vocals on this track [7]
- Jerry Garcia is believed to play pedal steel guitar on the first take [7]
- The first take of Good Lovin' appears on the Lowell George collection [8]
- This song is considered a bona fide Dead rarity [8]
- Robert Hunter discusses Garcia working out the hooks for this song [9]
- This recording is the same studio session as the one recorded immediately before it [3]
- This recording holds up better than the version on the Shakedown Street album [9]
- The overall vibe of the session reminds the listener of Let It Be [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd78-08-18.sbd.tzuriel.11504.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]
